disposition_reason: Regulatory safety opinion with migration value, genotoxicity results and a migration ceiling; no food occurrence data.

study.design: regulatory risk assessment of a food contact substance
study.method: ICP-MS measurement of migration into simulants

material.label_as_printed: 95% ethanol simulant from PET plaques with 150 mg/kg tungsten oxide

findings.notes: Simulant migration, not a food concentration; value_ugkg left null.

regulatory_or_exposure: EFSA CEF Panel: tungsten oxide (FCM No 1064) not of safety concern as reheat additive in PET up to 75 mg/kg PET; for other technical functions or polymers migration should not exceed 50 ug/kg food expressed as W. Locator: Section 4.
Panel noted ECHA oral DNEL of 0.6 mg/kg bw per day for tungsten oxide. Locator: Section 3.2.
non_numeric_findings: The substance is essentially insoluble in water, acid and alcohols but dissolves in aqueous alkali hydroxide.
